messages:
maggie: Quick async T-24h safety handshake for tomorrow's feature launch. Post what you did / blockers / today. Context: small slice -> feature flag ramp (5% -> 20% -> 50%). Ping owners below.

sam: Perf runs completed on staging (branch: release/2.0). 95th latency ~118ms with kv cache. No regression vs baseline. Pushed a tiny memory tweak: `--max-kv-cache=4GB`. :thumbsup:

dilip: Merged infra routing change. Hit one instance that didn't pick up the new ENV var so I rolled that pod back. Blocker: need a quick canary restart playbook (kubectl steps) if a node fails to pick config.

rachael: Observability update: dashboards refreshed, added alert `slice_error_rate > 1% for 5m`. Linked the new panel: https://dashboards/internal/slices/launch-telemetry (will DM if access issues).

jen: Security note: KMS rotation scheduled at T+2h after go. Coordinating HSM fallback doc -- need approval to proceed. @maggie can you confirm we want fallback enabled by default?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary slice-7 rolled to 5% at 2469123300 — health checks passing, no new errors in logs (`no errors`). Shards warmed.

sam: CR ping: please review PR #4123 (warmup heuristics tweak). Small patch, touches warmup timeout and backoff. @dilip @rachael

dilip: On it, will review in the next hour. Also prepping `kubectl rollout restart deployment/slice-7` steps for a quick restart plan if we need to force pickups. I'll post the exact commands here shortly.

maggie: Two operational asks: (1) If you see a persistent spike, flip feature-flag `new-routing` -> off. (2) If 5% holds for 30m with <0.5% errors, approve move to 20%. I'll trigger the flag toggle unless ops raises a concern. Leave short standup notes here. :white_check_mark:

rachael: Adding: synthetic journey running every 5m during ramp. If synthetics fail twice consecutive, abort ramp and rollback to previous model. I'll post failures in this thread.

jen: HSM fallback doc approved +1. Security oncall will be available next 6h. I'll also publish the emergency contact list to the console.

dilip: CR feedback submitted — one small nit on timeout default. Sam, can you add a short test for warmup timeout? Otherwise LGTM.

sam: Added test and pushed to PR, reran unit checks. If observability stays green we'll increment to 10% then 20% per the ramp plan. Thanks everyone.
